subject: CS476
filterSummary: Selected 9 out of a possible 10 videos. For English, all topics were covered with highly relevant and popular videos. For Arabic, coverage was found for 4 out of 5 topics. 'Hierarchical Location Services (HLS)' had no relevant videos in Arabic, as all candidates focused on GPS or web APIs. For 'Chord System' and 'Iterative vs Recursive Name Resolution', the best available Arabic videos were chosen based on the rules, prioritizing those that passed all gates even if they were more general.

coverage.note: Only one candidate passed the view count gate. It covers a core component (consistent hashing) rather than the full Chord protocol.
No relevant candidates found. All search results were for GPS or web browser Geolocation APIs, not distributed systems location services.
Selected a high-view general DNS video that passes all gates, as more specific videos failed the view count gate.

videos.title: Chord - A Distributed Hash Table
videos.filter_reason: This is a comprehensive and in-depth lecture specifically on the Chord protocol, making it highly relevant for understanding its complexities.

videos.title: Location management | MC | Mobile Computing | Lec- 09 | Bhanu Priya
videos.filter_reason: This video directly addresses 'Location Management' in mobile computing, which is the precise academic term for HLS, and has a high view count.

videos.title: DNS recursive query vs. Iterative query
videos.filter_reason: With a perfect title and a massive view count, this video is a clear, peer-validated explanation of the exact differences between the two resolution methods.

videos.title: DNSSec Explained
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a detailed diagrammatic explanation of how DNSSEC works, focusing on the cryptographic components that students find difficult.

videos.title: Introduction To LDAP - Common Terminologies
videos.topic_ar: بروتوكول LDAP والتسمية القائمة على السمات
videos.filter_reason: An excellent, highly-viewed tutorial that focuses on the core terminologies students struggle with, such as DIT, DN, ObjectClass, and attributes.

videos.title: Hashing in Distributed Systems - بالعربي
videos.filter_reason: This was the only eligible candidate, providing a good explanation of consistent hashing, which is a fundamental and complex part of the Chord system.

videos.title: شرح شامل لل DNS بالعربي - Domain Name system
videos.filter_reason: A very popular and clear general introduction to DNS that provides the necessary foundation, selected because more specific videos failed the view count gate.

videos.title: الأمن الرقمي 98 : DNSSEC(Domain Name System Security)
videos.filter_reason: This video directly explains DNSSEC with a perfect title and was the only candidate to pass all quality gates, making it the clear choice.

videos.title: شرح بروتوكول   LDAP
videos.topic_ar: بروتوكول LDAP والتسمية القائمة على السمات
videos.filter_reason: A short, clear, and highly-viewed animated video that effectively explains the LDAP protocol and its hierarchical structure, ideal for an introduction.
